adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `packages/core/EventManager.ts` changes `credentialId` assignment when building `referencesToCreate`: it was `credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId` and is now `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly later `result.credentialId ?? undefined`). This definitively drops `result.credentialId` for non-calendar (e.g., video) integrations, whereas previously the created reference would retain the credential used. Given other code paths in this diff rely on `reference.credentialId` to select/fetch the correct credential (and otherwise fall back to type-based matching), removing it can break updates/deletes in cases with multiple credentials of the same integration type.
